symptom: PC1 cannot ping PC2 although both should be in VLAN 10.
show_output: SW1# show vlan brief; 10 Users active Fa0/3; 20 Guests active Fa0/4; PC1 is on Fa0/3 and PC2 is on Fa0/4; intended VLAN: 10 for both PCs.
expected_fault: PC2 access port is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10.
expected_fix: Reassign port Fa0/4 to access VLAN 10.
expected_evidence: show vlan brief places PC1 on Fa0/3 in VLAN 10 and PC2 on Fa0/4 in VLAN 20 despite the stated intended VLAN 10.

symptom: Devices assigned to VLAN 40 cannot communicate on SW2.
show_output: SW2# show vlan brief; 10 Staff active Fa0/1-8; 20 Voice active Fa0/9-12; VLAN 40 is not listed; Fa0/15 and Fa0/16 are assigned access VLAN 40 in show running-config.
expected_fault: VLAN 40 is missing from SW2.
expected_fix: Create VLAN 40 in SW2 VLAN database.
expected_evidence: show vlan brief does not list VLAN 40 while show running-config assigns Fa0/15 and Fa0/16 to access VLAN 40.

symptom: Users in VLAN 30 on SW1 cannot reach users in VLAN 30 on SW2.
show_output: SW1# show interfaces trunk; Gi0/1 trunking; Vlans allowed on trunk: 10,20; Vlans allowed and active: 10,20; PC5 and PC6 access ports are in VLAN 30.
expected_fault: VLAN 30 is not allowed on the inter-switch trunk.
expected_fix: Add VLAN 30 to allowed list on Gi0/1 trunk interface.
expected_evidence: show interfaces trunk lists only VLANs 10 and 20 as allowed and active on Gi0/1; the affected PCs are in VLAN 30.

symptom: Traffic crossing the SW3-R1 trunk intermittently fails for untagged management traffic.
show_output: SW3# show interfaces trunk; Gi0/2 native vlan 99; R1# show interfaces Gi0/0 trunk; Native VLAN: 1.
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch between SW3 and R1.
expected_fix: Configure native VLAN 99 on R1 Gi0/0 trunk interface to match SW3.
expected_evidence: The supplied trunk outputs show native VLAN 99 on SW3 Gi0/2 and native VLAN 1 on R1 Gi0/0.

symptom: PC7 cannot communicate with peers in its intended VLAN 50.
show_commands: show vlan brief, show running-config interface Fa0/13
show_output: SW4# show vlan brief; 50 Engineering active Fa0/10-12; SW4# show running-config interface Fa0/13; switchport mode access; switchport access vlan 1; PC7 is connected to Fa0/13.
expected_fault: PC7 port Fa0/13 is not assigned to VLAN 50.
expected_fix: Reassign port Fa0/13 to access VLAN 50.
expected_evidence: VLAN 50 exists and uses Fa0/10-12, but the configuration for PC7's Fa0/13 explicitly sets access VLAN 1.

symptom: PC1 can reach its gateway but not Server1 at 192.168.30.10.
show_output: R1# show ip route; C 192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected; C 192.168.20.0/24 is directly connected; no entry for 192.168.30.0/24.
expected_fault: R1 has no route to remote network 192.168.30.0/24.
expected_fix: Add static route for 192.168.30.0/24 on R1.
expected_evidence: The routing table contains only the listed connected networks and no route for Server1's 192.168.30.0/24 network.

symptom: Hosts behind R3 cannot reach 10.30.0.0/16.
show_commands: show ip route, show ip interface brief
show_output: R3# show ip route; S 10.30.0.0/16 [1/0] via 172.16.4.99; R3# show ip interface brief; Gi0/1 172.16.4.1 up up; R4 neighbor address on the link is documented as 172.16.4.2.
expected_fault: Static route uses incorrect next hop 172.16.4.99.
expected_fix: Correct static route next-hop address to 172.16.4.2.
expected_evidence: The route points to 172.16.4.99 while the supplied link topology identifies R4 at 172.16.4.2.

symptom: Branch users cannot reach external networks.
show_output: R5# show ip route; C 10.5.0.0/24 is directly connected; Gateway of last resort is not set.
expected_fault: R5 is missing a default route.
expected_fix: Configure default route ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 to upstream router.
expected_evidence: show ip route explicitly states that the gateway of last resort is not set.

symptom: HQ users cannot reach 172.16.60.0/24.
topology_note: HQ LAN -> R6 -> R7 -> remote LAN
show_commands: show ip route, show cdp neighbors detail
show_output: R6# show ip route; O 172.16.60.0/24 [110/20] via 10.6.67.7; show cdp neighbors detail identifies R7 on the R6-R7 link as 10.6.67.2.
expected_fault: OSPF route advertises an incorrect next-hop address for the R6-R7 path.
expected_fix: Reconfigure OSPF network interface neighbor IP to 10.6.67.2.
expected_evidence: The route's next hop is 10.6.67.7, but supplied CDP topology identifies R7's link address as 10.6.67.2.

symptom: Sales LAN cannot reach the data-center 192.168.80.0/24 network.
show_commands: show ip route, show ip interface brief
show_output: R8# show ip route; S 192.168.80.0/24 [1/0] via 10.8.89.9; R8# show ip interface brief; Gi0/1 10.8.89.1 up up; R9 link address is 10.8.89.2.
expected_fault: Route to 192.168.80.0/24 points to the wrong next hop.
expected_fix: Update static route next-hop to 10.8.89.2.
expected_evidence: R8 has a route but it points to 10.8.89.9 instead of the documented R9 address 10.8.89.2.

symptom: PC8 can reach its gateway but not a remote server.
show_output: PC8 can ping its gateway 192.168.90.1; no show ip route, ACL, or interface output is supplied.
expected_fault: Insufficient evidence; routing, ACL, or interface path issues remain possible.
expected_fix: Collect show ip route, show access-lists, and interface outputs before configuring.
expected_evidence: Gateway reachability is known, but there is no routing-table, ACL, or interface evidence for the remote path.

symptom: PC9 intermittently loses access while another PC uses the same network.
show_output: R11# show arp; Internet 192.168.100.10 0 aaaa.bbbb.0001 ARPA Gi0/0; Internet 192.168.100.10 0 cccc.dddd.0002 ARPA Gi0/0.
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address 192.168.100.10 is in use.
expected_fix: Reassign unique IP address to one of the conflicting hosts.
expected_evidence: The ARP table shows the same IP address 192.168.100.10 mapped to two different MAC addresses.

symptom: PC11 cannot reach its default gateway.
expected_fault: PC11 has the wrong subnet mask.
expected_fix: Update PC11 subnet mask to 255.255.255.0.
expected_evidence: PC11 uses 255.255.0.0 while its gateway interface is supplied with 255.255.255.0 for the same LAN.

symptom: PC12 cannot reach servers outside its subnet.
expected_fault: PC12 has a default gateway mismatch.
expected_fix: Update PC12 default gateway to 192.168.110.1.
expected_evidence: PC12 belongs to 192.168.110.0/24, but its configured gateway is 192.168.120.1 while R13 provides 192.168.110.1.

symptom: PC13 cannot communicate with local hosts or its gateway.
expected_fault: PC13 IP address is in the wrong subnet for its connected gateway interface.
expected_fix: Change PC13 IP address to available address in 172.16.13.0/24.
expected_evidence: PC13 uses 172.16.12.0/24, whereas the connected R14 interface is in 172.16.13.0/24.

symptom: PC14 obtains an address but cannot reach any routed networks.
expected_fault: PC14 gateway is configured as .254 instead of the available .1 gateway.
expected_fix: Set PC14 gateway to 192.168.140.1.
expected_evidence: The PC gateway is 192.168.140.254 while the supplied active router LAN interface is 192.168.140.1.

symptom: New clients in VLAN 60 receive no IP address.
show_commands: show ip dhcp pool, show ip interface brief
show_output: R16# show ip dhcp pool; Pool STAFF; Network 192.168.60.0/24; no pool for VLAN 60 network 192.168.160.0/24. R16# show ip interface brief; Gi0/1.60 192.168.160.1 up up.
expected_fault: DHCP pool for VLAN 60 network 192.168.160.0/24 is missing.
expected_fix: Configure ip dhcp pool for 192.168.160.0/24 on R16.
expected_evidence: The active VLAN 60 gateway is 192.168.160.1, but show ip dhcp pool has no pool for 192.168.160.0/24.

symptom: Clients on the 10.20.30.0/24 LAN receive no usable lease.
show_commands: show ip dhcp pool, show ip interface brief
show_output: R17# show ip dhcp pool; Pool LAB; Network 10.20.0.0 255.255.0.0; R17# show ip interface brief; Gi0/0 10.20.30.1 up up.
expected_fault: DHCP pool has the wrong network and mask for the client LAN.
expected_fix: Reconfigure DHCP pool LAB network to 10.20.30.0 255.255.255.0.
expected_evidence: The DHCP pool is 10.20.0.0/16 while the supplied client gateway interface is the 10.20.30.0/24 LAN.

symptom: DHCP clients receive addresses but cannot reach off-subnet resources.
show_commands: show running-config, show ip interface brief
show_output: R18# show running-config | section dhcp; ip dhcp pool FINANCE; network 192.168.170.0 255.255.255.0; default-router 192.168.170.254. R18# show ip interface brief; Gi0/2 192.168.170.1 up up.
expected_fault: DHCP pool advertises an incorrect default router.
expected_fix: Update default-router in pool FINANCE to 192.168.170.1.
expected_evidence: The pool's default-router is .254, while the supplied active gateway interface is 192.168.170.1.

symptom: New clients cannot obtain addresses from the 192.168.180.0/24 pool.
show_output: R19# show ip dhcp pool; Pool TRAINING; Network 192.168.180.0/24; Total addresses 254; Leased addresses 0; Excluded addresses 254.
expected_fault: All usable DHCP addresses are excluded from the pool.
expected_fix: Adjust ip dhcp excluded-address range to leave available host addresses.
expected_evidence: show ip dhcp pool reports 254 excluded addresses and zero leased addresses for a /24 pool.

symptom: Users on 192.168.210.0/24 cannot reach the web server at 10.50.0.10 on TCP 80.
show_commands: show access-lists, show running-config interface Gi0/0
show_output: R20# show access-lists; Extended IP access list WEB-FILTER; 10 deny tcp 192.168.210.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.50.0.10 eq 80; 20 permit ip any any. R20# show running-config interface Gi0/0; ip access-group WEB-FILTER in.
expected_fault: Inbound ACL explicitly denies required HTTP traffic.
expected_fix: Remove or modify line 10 in WEB-FILTER ACL to permit TCP port 80.
expected_evidence: WEB-FILTER is applied inbound on Gi0/0 and its first entry denies TCP port 80 from the user subnet to 10.50.0.10.

symptom: Remote management traffic from 10.22.0.0/24 is blocked at R21.
show_commands: show running-config interface Gi0/1, show access-lists
show_output: R21# show running-config interface Gi0/1; ip access-group MGMT-BLOCK out. R21# show access-lists; Extended IP access list MGMT-BLOCK; 10 deny ip 10.22.0.0 0.0.0.255 any; 20 permit ip any any. Topology shows management traffic enters Gi0/1 from 10.22.0.0/24.
expected_fault: ACL is applied in the wrong direction for the intended inbound traffic control.
expected_fix: Change ip access-group MGMT-BLOCK application on Gi0/1 from out to in.
expected_evidence: The deny rule targets the source network, but the ACL is applied outbound even though the traffic enters Gi0/1.

symptom: Guest devices cannot access the internet even though the policy should restrict only internal servers.
show_commands: show running-config interface Gi0/0.70, show access-lists
show_output: R22# show running-config interface Gi0/0.70; ip access-group GUEST-POLICY in. R22# show access-lists; Extended IP access list GUEST-POLICY; 10 deny ip 192.168.70.0 0.0.0.255 any; 20 permit ip any any.
expected_fault: ACL is applied to the guest VLAN interface and denies all guest traffic, not only internal-server access.
expected_fix: Modify GUEST-POLICY to deny internal subnets only while permitting internet destinations.
expected_evidence: GUEST-POLICY is inbound on the guest interface and line 10 denies the entire guest subnet to any destination.

symptom: Engineering hosts cannot reach the permitted 172.16.240.0/24 service network.
show_commands: show access-lists, show running-config interface Gi0/0
show_output: R23# show access-lists; Extended IP access list ENG-OUT; 10 deny ip 10.24.0.0 0.0.255.255 172.16.240.0 0.0.0.255; 20 permit ip any any. R23# show running-config interface Gi0/0; ip access-group ENG-OUT in.
expected_fault: ACL denies the engineering network that should be allowed to the service network.
expected_fix: Remove or adjust line 10 in ENG-OUT ACL to allow engineering traffic to 172.16.240.0/24.
expected_evidence: The applied inbound ACL explicitly denies 10.24.0.0/16 traffic to 172.16.240.0/24 before the permit any rule.

symptom: PC15 has no network connectivity through R24 Gi0/0.
show_output: R24# show ip interface brief; GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.250.1 YES manual administratively down down.
expected_fault: R24 Gi0/0 is administratively down.
expected_fix: Execute no shutdown on R24 Gi0/0 interface.
expected_evidence: show ip interface brief explicitly reports GigabitEthernet0/0 as administratively down and down.

symptom: R25 GigabitEthernet0/1 link is physically down.
show_output: R25# show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/1; GigabitEthernet0/1 is down, line protocol is down (disabled); Last input never.
expected_fault: R25 Gi0/1 is physically down.
expected_fix: Check physical cabling and transceiver on R25 Gi0/1 and verify switch port state.
expected_evidence: show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/1 reports interface is down and line protocol is down with Last input never.

symptom: PC17 connected to SW17 Fa0/18 has no link light or network access.
show_commands: show running-config interface Fa0/18, show interfaces status
show_output: SW17# show interfaces status; Fa0/18 disabled; show running-config interface Fa0/18 contains shutdown.
expected_fault: SW17 Fa0/18 is shut down in its interface configuration.
expected_fix: Enter interface Fa0/18 configuration mode on SW17 and issue no shutdown command.
expected_evidence: show interfaces status reports Fa0/18 disabled and show running-config contains shutdown.

symptom: PC17 cannot resolve domain names though IP ping to DNS server 10.60.0.10 succeeds.
show_output: PC17 ipconfig /all shows DNS Server: 10.60.0.53; ping 10.60.0.10 succeeds; documented DNS server IP is 10.60.0.10.
expected_fault: PC17 is configured with the wrong DNS server address 10.60.0.53 instead of 10.60.0.10.
expected_fix: Update PC17 DNS server setting to 10.60.0.10.
expected_evidence: PC17 ping to 10.60.0.10 succeeds, but PC17 uses DNS server 10.60.0.53 while topology states DNS is 10.60.0.10.

symptom: PC18 can reach its default gateway but cannot resolve portal.lab.local.
show_output: PC18 can ping gateway 172.16.30.1; nslookup portal.lab.local times out; no server service status output supplied.
expected_fault: Insufficient evidence; DNS configuration, DNS reachability, or DNS service availability are unconfirmed.
expected_fix: Check DNS server service status and verify DNS query path reachability before configuring host settings.
expected_evidence: PC18 can reach its default gateway but cannot resolve portal.lab.local with no server status output.

symptom: Clients using DNS server 172.16.30.53 receive query time-outs despite IP ping reachability.
show_output: Ping to 172.16.30.53 succeeds; DNS Server configuration states DNS Service: Off.
expected_fault: DNS service is disabled on the reachable DNS server at 172.16.30.53.
expected_fix: Enable DNS service on server 172.16.30.53 and verify service status is On.
expected_evidence: DNS server 172.16.30.53 responds to ping but server DNS service status is explicitly Off.
